title: Local computation of MIS with polynomial degree dependence — resolved
question: Does there exist a randomized local computation algorithm which, for every n-vertex simple undirected graph of maximum degree at most Δ, answers whether any requested vertex belongs to one consistently chosen maximal independent set, using at most C(Δ+1)^a(log(n+1))^b graph probes per answer? Here C,a,b are absolute constants, and with probability at least 1−1/n all n answers are jointly correct and meet the probe bound. The answer is yes, by Ghaffari’s FOCS 2022 result.
